items.title: Apple Releasing HomePod Mini 2 Tomorrow With These New Features
items.excerpt: Following more than two weeks of pre-orders, the HomePod mini 2 will begin arriving to customers and launch in stores this Friday, October 30. Siri AI will be one of the HomePod mini 2's key upgrades, but the feature will not be available at launch. Apple said Siri AI support on the speaker will arrive in a future software update, but it did not say when the update will be released.

items.excerpt: Amazon's first digital picture frame squeezes in Alexa+, which picks your best photos based on lighting, smiles and the season, and lets you attach voice notes to images.

items.title: Raycast’s new iOS keyboard app lets you dictate, swipe type and use AI commands without switching apps
items.excerpt: Raycast's new iPhone keyboard combines swipe typing, AI writing tools, voice dictation, GIF search, and text shortcuts. You can now access its productivity features without switching keyboards.

items.title: Strava adds Google Gemini integration with personalized workout insights
items.excerpt: Strava expanded its AI integrations with Google Gemini this week, allowing subscribers to get personalized insights based on their workout history.

items.title: Cybersecurity bounty hunter says Samsung TVs use AI to record audio and screenshots for ads —
items.excerpt: A security researcher says Samsung smart TVs run on-device AI and computer-vision models that collect audio, screenshots and cross-device ad IDs for ad targeting, from tracking skipped ads to using connected soundbars as microphones.
